QUOTE: In the library: nothing spawns a thread. The thread layer's only library-side lock is the wrapper `threading_mutex_lock_pthread` (`library/threading.c:75`)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the library spawns no threads, and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (mbedtls_mutex_* wrappers) that other library code and threaded callers use.
